plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, images, annotations counts), (3) annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean), (4) category distribution (how many annotations per category), (5) image dimensions, (6) structure of metadata.json, (7) reference product images in data/products/. Log all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data properties: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Check environment and install dependencies
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Verify GPU availability and VRAM. Install any missing packages.
plan.success_criteria: All required packages available, GPU confirmed

plan.title: Install dependencies and verify GPU
plan.hypothesis: Installing torch with CUDA support will reveal GPU availability; all required packages can be installed
plan.description: Run pip install for ultralytics==8.1.0, torch==2.6.0+cu124, torchvision==0.21.0+cu124, timm==0.9.12, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Then verify torch.cuda.is_available() and print GPU info. This is critical before any training.
plan.success_criteria: All packages installed successfully, GPU status confirmed

plan.title: Create train/val split, evaluation function, and YOLO dataset
plan.description: Write scripts to: (1) Split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json (90/10, seed=42, stratified by image). (2) Implement val_score = 0.7 * detection_mAP@0.5 + 0.3 * classification_mAP@0.5 evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval. (3) Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format for both splits. Create dataset YAML config for both nc=1 and nc=356 variants.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, YOLO format labels generated, evaluation function tested

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A single-class YOLOv8m detector at 640px establishes a solid detection baseline, achieving detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.3
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=1 (all categories mapped to class 0), imgsz=640, epochs=80, batch=16. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. This establishes the detection baseline for the two-stage pipeline.

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves with small products, gaining 5+ mAP points
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=100, batch=8. Compare detection_mAP to 640px baseline.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 improves by 5+ points over 640px baseline

plan.title: Build DINOv2 classification pipeline and test on GT crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base kNN classification on ground-truth val crops achieves top-1 accuracy > 30% and classification_mAP > 0.15
plan.description: Analyze data/products/ reference images. Implement DINOv2-base (dinov2_vitb14 from torch.hub or timm) embedding pipeline: extract embeddings from training crops, build gallery from training crops + reference images, classify via cosine similarity kNN. Test on ground-truth val crops to measure classification upper bound. Also test DINOv2-large if time permits.
plan.success_criteria: Classification pipeline working, top-1 accuracy > 30% on GT val crops

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: best detector + DINOv2 classification end-to-end
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves val_score > 0.25
plan.description: Run best nc=1 detector on val images, crop detections, classify with DINOv2 kNN. Compute full val_score (0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP). This is the first end-to-end evaluation. Tune confidence threshold and kNN k simultaneously.

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=1 at 1280 + detection tuning
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l provides better detection than YOLOv8m at 1280, and NMS/conf tuning adds 1-3 mAP points
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=150, batch=4. Also sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7} and confidence threshold {0.001,0.01,0.05,0.1} on val split with best detector.

plan.title: SAHI tiled inference + TTA
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference at 1280 with overlap improves detection of small products by 3+ mAP points
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Also test TTA (horizontal flip). Compare detection_mAP to single-pass.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by 2+ points over single-pass

plan.title: Optimize classification: DINOv2-large, gallery tuning, kNN sweep
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large + optimized gallery improves classification_mAP by 3+ points
plan.description: Test DINOv2-large (dinov2_vitl14), sweep k in {1,3,5,7}, test cosine vs L2, compare gallery variants (reference only, training crops only, combined). Check model size fits within 420MB budget.

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=356 comparison and potential hybrid
plan.hypothesis: End-to-end nc=356 YOLO may be competitive with two-stage for some categories
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=356, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, close_mosaic=50. Compare both detection_mAP and classification_mAP to two-stage pipeline. Determine if hybrid approach (YOLO class when confident, DINOv2 otherwise) is beneficial.
plan.success_criteria: Determine whether hybrid or pure two-stage is better

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and val_score evaluation
plan.description: Assemble best detection + classification configuration. Apply any remaining optimizations: spatial consistency, co-occurrence priors, confidence calibration. Run complete pipeline on val split. Time inference and check model sizes.

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission with run.py, model weights (≤3 files, ≤420MB), gallery file, helper files. Verify sandbox compatibility (no os/sys/subprocess, use pathlib). Test extraction and run on val split end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces valid predictions.json, all constraints met
